steps.text: Sort the fruits. Remove any that are cracked, soft or rotten.
Keep them out of direct sunlight.
Store in a well-ventilated place. Use open crates or baskets.
Do not pile them too high. Heavy piles bruise the fruit at the bottom.
Check every day. Remove any fruit that is going bad so it does not spoil the others.
Keep in a cool, airy place.
Keep them dry. Do not wash them before storing.
Plan to sell or use them within a few days.
Ripe tomatoes do not keep long. Sell or use them first.
Separate soft or cracked fruits straight away.
Keep in a cool, shaded and airy place.
Use shallow containers so the fruit at the bottom is not crushed.
